## Postmortem: CoD-fidelity browser FPS (run 34092038605, issue #58)

### Outcome
Shipped STRIKE PROTOCOL, a zero-dependency single-file raycaster FPS (~49KB index.html + game/index.html), verified in real headless Chrome against both localhost:3000 and the public Cloudflare tunnel (title, deploy, combat, pause, win/fail, persistence all green, zero page errors), with 8 final-* screenshots, branch opencode/34092038605 pushed (e04c111), and completion evidence posted to issue #58. Workflow steps report success except Delivery (not yet run).

### What worked
- 7 high-signal CoD anchors recorded with URLs+purpose in PROGRESS.md and mapped to concrete HUD/loop decisions.
- Real-browser verification loop (puppeteer-core + installed Chrome) was the highest-value activity: screenshots plus state assertions (kills, HP, mode, XP across reload) proved the full gameplay loop.
- Fresh-context critic subagent produced a ranked 5-gap list; the top gap (touch Mission-2 soft-lock) got fixed.
- Build-then-verify discipline: node vm syntax checks gated every edit; PROGRESS.md stayed resumable throughout.

### What did not work
- Syntax-only verification gave false confidence: two load/frame-time run
prompt_alignment: File blind A/B or anchor-comparison captures as explicit evidence, or log their absence as a known gap.
For browser deliverables, require a real-browser smoke test with zero console errors and a screenshot before any completion claim.
Paste the exact completion-evidence format into working notes so submissions are accepted first time.
State the artifact shape (static file vs build/start script) up front and make serve steps match it.
When localhost checks fail from CLI, retry once then verify through the real browser transport and record the sandbox limitation.

skill_recommendations.name: browser-verify
skill_recommendations.reason: No existing skill covers driving a page with headless Chrome, capturing screenshots, and asserting console/state; hand-rolled puppeteer scripts filled the gap and caught the two critical runtime bugs. A reusable skill would standardize this.

skill_recommendations.name: gauntlet-loop
skill_recommendations.reason: Existed and fit the build-critique-fix loop the goal demanded, but was never invoked; keep and trigger it explicitly for multi-gap polish phases.

skill_recommendations.name: load-sketchfab-threejs
skill_recommendations.reason: Correctly not used: the zero-dep 2.5D raycaster needed no GLB assets; invoking it would have added unjustified complexity.

skill_recommendations.name: mcp-duckgo
skill_recommendations.reason: Research succeeded via built-in websearch instead; DuckDuckGo skill was sufficient-but-unused, no change needed.
